paper_title: Detecting Ultralight Bosonic Dark Matter via Absorption in Superconductors
notes: Projection (sensitivity, not measured limit) for absorption of kinetically mixed hidden photon DM in an Al superconductor target (1 kg-yr exposure). Paper also presents projections for pseudoscalar (g_aee, Fig 4) and scalar (d_phiee, Fig 5) couplings. Dark photon (kinetic mixing kappa) chosen as primary result per Fig 3. Data points are rough reads from log-log plot for the kg-yr curve; approximate. rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. 95% CL stated in text. | Vision: Traced the thick solid black '1 kg-yr' Al superconductor projected sensitivity curve (lower boundary of reach) in Fig. 3. Y-axis is kinetic mixing kappa. Curve rises steeply at low mass (~1-3 meV) then declines toward high mass. Dip near omega_D ~0.037 eV and small bumps from sigma_1 structure visible. | Calibration: No calibration needed
